description: Manage a product catalog from schema definition through data quality validation.

steps.description: Define the product data schema including SKU format, attributes, images, and pricing fields.

inputs.name: product-categories
inputs.desc: List of product categories to support

outputs.name: sku-format
outputs.desc: SKU naming convention and format rules

process: Define the core product fields (title, description, price, weight, dimensions).
Design the SKU format with category, variant, and sequence components.
Specify image requirements (sizes, formats, alt text rules).
Document the pricing fields (base price, sale price, MAP, cost).

steps.description: Write product descriptions following naming conventions and SEO guidelines.
process: Establish title templates by category (brand, product type, key attribute, size).
Write descriptions with features, benefits, and specifications.
Apply SEO guidelines to titles and descriptions.
Validate descriptions against the schema.

steps.description: Categorize and tag products for navigation, filtering, and search.

outputs.name: categorized-catalog
outputs.desc: Products assigned to categories and tags

process: Build the category hierarchy (department, category, subcategory).
Define filter attributes per category (size, color, material, brand).
Assign products to categories and apply tags.
Validate that every product has at least one category and required tags.

steps.description: Set up variant management for products with multiple options (size, color, style).

outputs.name: variant-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for variant creation and pricing

process: Identify which products need variants and which option types apply.
Define variant-level fields (SKU suffix, price differential, inventory tracking).
Configure parent-child relationships between base products and variants.
Set rules for variant images, descriptions, and pricing overrides.

steps.description: Validate the catalog for data quality, completeness, and consistency.
process: Check every product for required fields (title, description, price, image, category).
Validate SKU uniqueness and format compliance.
Flag duplicate products and inconsistent pricing.
Produce the quality report and define the ongoing review cadence.

description: Forecast inventory needs from historical sales data through purchase order generation.

steps.description: Collect and prepare historical sales data for demand forecasting.

outputs.name: data-quality-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on data gaps or anomalies

process: Extract sales data by SKU for the analysis period (12 to 24 months).
Clean the data (remove returns, correct duplicates, fill gaps).
Flag anomalies (stockouts, promotions, one-time events) for adjustment.
Aggregate to the forecasting time bucket (daily, weekly, monthly).

steps.description: Identify seasonal patterns, trends, and demand drivers in sales history.

outputs.name: demand-patterns
outputs.desc: Identified seasonality, trends, and demand drivers

process: Decompose the time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components.
Identify the seasonal pattern (weekly, monthly, annual cycles).
Test forecasting methods (moving average, exponential smoothing, regression).
Select the best model based on forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE, MAE).

steps.description: Calculate reorder points and safety stock levels for each product.

outputs.name: reorder-points
outputs.desc: Reorder point and safety stock per SKU

outputs.name: lead-time-assumptions
outputs.desc: Lead time data used in calculations

process: Gather supplier lead times and lead time variability.
Calculate average demand and demand variability during lead time.
Compute safety stock at the target service level (95% or 99%).
Set the reorder point as average demand during lead time plus safety stock.

steps.description: Model demand scenarios to stress-test inventory plans.

outputs.name: scenario-results
outputs.desc: Results from base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios

outputs.name: risk-assessment
outputs.desc: Stockout and overstock risk by SKU

process: Define scenarios: base case, high demand (+20%), low demand (-20%).
Run each scenario through the inventory model.
Calculate stockout probability and excess inventory cost per scenario.
Identify high-risk SKUs that need closer monitoring.

steps.description: Generate purchase orders based on the forecast and reorder points.
process: Identify SKUs at or below the reorder point.
Calculate order quantities (economic order quantity or fixed period).
Group orders by supplier to minimize shipping costs.
Generate the purchase orders and the inventory forecast summary.

description: Process customer returns from request through refund and inventory update.

steps.description: Verify the return request against the return policy.

inputs.name: return-request
inputs.desc: Customer return request with order details

outputs.name: eligibility-result
outputs.desc: Whether the return is eligible and why

process: Check the return window (days since delivery).
Verify the product is in a returnable category.
Confirm the reason code matches eligible reasons.
Determine the return type based on policy and customer preference.

steps.description: Issue the return merchandise authorization and shipping instructions.

outputs.name: return-authorization
outputs.desc: RMA number and return shipping label

process: Generate the RMA number.
Create the return shipping label (prepaid or customer-paid per policy).
Send the authorization and instructions to the customer.
Log the return in the order management system.

steps.description: Receive and inspect the returned item for condition and restockability.

outputs.name: restock-decision
outputs.desc: Whether to restock, refurbish, or dispose

process: Receive the package and verify the RMA number.
Inspect the item against the return condition requirements.
Grade the item (like new, open box, damaged, defective).
Decide the disposition: restock, refurbish, liquidate, or dispose.

steps.description: Process the refund, exchange, or store credit based on the inspection.
process: Calculate the refund amount (full, partial, or restocking fee).
Process the payment reversal or issue store credit.
For exchanges, create the replacement order.
Send the confirmation notification to the customer.

steps.description: Update inventory and produce the returns summary report.
process: Update inventory counts for restocked items.
Record dispositions for non-restockable items.
Calculate return rate, refund total, and reason breakdown.
Produce the returns summary report.

description: Optimize an online storefront for conversion rate improvement.

steps.description: Audit the current conversion funnel to identify drop-off points.

inputs.name: storefront-url
inputs.desc: URL of the storefront to audit

outputs.name: funnel-analysis
outputs.desc: Conversion rates and drop-off points by stage

process: Map the funnel stages (landing, browse, product view, add to cart, checkout, purchase).
Calculate conversion rates between each stage.
Identify the stages with the largest drop-off.
Rank issues by estimated revenue impact.

steps.description: Analyze page load speed and mobile usability.

outputs.name: performance-scores
outputs.desc: Core Web Vitals and mobile usability scores

process: Measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) for key pages.
Test mobile responsiveness on common device sizes.
Identify the largest render-blocking resources.
Prioritize fixes by impact on the conversion funnel.

steps.description: Review product page layouts, CTAs, and information hierarchy.

inputs.name: funnel-analysis
inputs.desc: Funnel analysis with product page drop-off data

process: Review image quality, quantity, and zoom functionality.
Assess the CTA placement, color, and copy.
Check the information hierarchy (price, reviews, shipping, returns).
Identify missing trust signals (reviews, guarantees, security badges).

steps.description: Test the checkout flow for friction points and abandonment triggers.

inputs.name: funnel-analysis
inputs.desc: Funnel analysis with checkout drop-off data

process: Walk through the checkout as a guest and registered user.
Count the steps and form fields required.
Test payment method availability and error handling.
Identify surprise costs (shipping, tax revealed late).

steps.description: Design and measure A/B tests on key storefront pages.

outputs.name: test-plan
outputs.desc: A/B test plan with hypotheses and success metrics

process: Prioritize test hypotheses by expected conversion impact.
Calculate required sample sizes for statistical significance.
Design the test variants and tracking setup.
Define the success criteria and produce the optimization report.

description: Recover abandoned shopping carts through automated email and on-site interventions.

steps.description: Identify cart abandonment triggers and segment abandoners.

inputs.name: abandonment-goals
inputs.desc: Target recovery rate and revenue goals

outputs.name: abandonment-segments
outputs.desc: Segments of cart abandoners by behavior

process: Calculate the overall cart abandonment rate.
Segment abandoners by stage (browse, add to cart, start checkout, payment).
Identify the top abandonment triggers (shipping cost, account creation, payment issues).
Prioritize segments by cart value and recovery likelihood.

steps.description: Design the cart recovery email sequence with timing, content, and incentives.

outputs.name: email-sequence
outputs.desc: Recovery email sequence (timing, subject, content, offers)

outputs.name: incentive-rules
outputs.desc: Discount and incentive rules by segment

process: Design the email cadence (1 hour, 24 hours, 72 hours after abandonment).
Write subject lines and body copy for each email.
Define incentive tiers (no discount first, then percentage or free shipping).
Set rules for which segments receive which incentive level.

steps.description: Set up browse abandonment flows for visitors who viewed but did not add to cart.

outputs.name: browse-flows
outputs.desc: Browse abandonment email and retargeting flows

outputs.name: audience-rules
outputs.desc: Audience targeting rules for each flow

process: Define browse abandonment criteria (viewed product, no add to cart within 1 hour).
Design the browse abandonment email with product recommendations.
Set up retargeting audience rules for ad platforms.
Configure frequency caps to avoid over-messaging.

steps.description: Implement exit-intent offers to capture visitors before they leave.
process: Design the exit-intent popup (timing, trigger, copy, offer).
Create variants for A/B testing (discount vs free shipping vs urgency).
Set display rules (once per session, exclude returning customers, exclude mobile).
Configure the email capture for anonymous visitors.

steps.description: Track recovery rate, revenue, and optimize the recovery program.

outputs.name: recovery-metrics
outputs.desc: Recovery rate, revenue recovered, and cost per recovery

outputs.name: cart-recovery-plan
outputs.desc: Cart recovery program plan and optimization roadmap

process: Track open rate, click rate, and conversion rate per email in the sequence.
Calculate revenue recovered and cost per recovery (discounts given).
Compare recovery rates across segments and channels.
Identify the highest-performing tactics and produce the optimization plan.

description: Set and optimize pricing for an e-commerce catalog.

steps.description: Analyze competitor pricing across the product catalog.

outputs.name: price-position
outputs.desc: Current price position relative to competitors

process: Collect competitor prices for overlapping SKUs.
Calculate the price index (your price / average competitor price).
Identify where you are above, at, or below market.
Flag products with MAP (minimum advertised price) constraints.

steps.description: Calculate cost-plus margins and identify margin improvement opportunities.

outputs.name: margin-analysis
outputs.desc: Margin analysis by SKU and category

outputs.name: pricing-constraints
outputs.desc: Minimum price floors and margin targets

process: Calculate landed cost per SKU (product cost, shipping, duties, fees).
Compute current margin and target margin by category.
Identify negative-margin and below-target SKUs.
Set price floors based on minimum margin requirements.

steps.description: Test price elasticity to find the revenue-maximizing price point.

outputs.name: elasticity-results
outputs.desc: Price elasticity estimates by product or category

process: Select test products across price sensitivity categories.
Design the price test (A/B test, time-series comparison, or conjoint analysis).
Measure the volume response to price changes.
Estimate the elasticity coefficient and compute the optimal price.

steps.description: Set promotional pricing rules for sales, bundles, and volume discounts.
process: Define promotional discount tiers (10%, 20%, clearance).
Set rules for which products can be promoted and how often.
Design bundle offers and volume discount thresholds.
Build the promotional pricing calendar.

steps.description: Monitor the margin impact of pricing changes and produce the strategy document.

outputs.name: pricing-impact-report
outputs.desc: Revenue and margin impact of pricing changes

process: Track revenue, margin, and unit volume after each price change.
Compare actual results against the elasticity model predictions.
Identify products where pricing changes underperformed.
Produce the pricing strategy document with recommendations.

description: Fulfill customer orders from payment verification through carrier handoff.

steps.description: Verify payment and inventory availability for incoming orders.

inputs.name: order-details
inputs.desc: Incoming order with items and payment

outputs.name: hold-list
outputs.desc: Orders on hold (payment or stock issues)

process: Verify the payment authorization is valid.
Check inventory availability for each line item.
Flag backorder items and calculate the estimated ship date.
Route verified orders to the pick queue.

steps.description: Coordinate the pick and pack process for verified orders.
process: Generate the pick list sorted by warehouse zone.
Pick items and scan to verify against the order.
Pack items with appropriate materials and packing slip.
Record pick accuracy and flag any discrepancies.

steps.description: Generate shipping labels and select the optimal carrier.

inputs.name: packed-order
inputs.desc: Packed order with dimensions and weight

inputs.name: verified-order
inputs.desc: Order with shipping address and service level

outputs.name: shipping-cost
outputs.desc: Actual shipping cost for the order

process: Calculate package dimensions and weight.
Rate-shop across carriers for the selected service level.
Generate the shipping label and tracking number.
Record the shipping cost against the order.

steps.description: Hand off the package to the carrier and send the tracking notification.
process: Schedule carrier pickup or drop at the shipping station.
Scan the package out of the warehouse.
Send the tracking notification to the customer.
Record the shipment in the order management system.

description: Set up as a marketplace seller across multiple channels.

steps.description: Select the marketplace channels based on product fit and audience.

outputs.name: channel-requirements
outputs.desc: Account and listing requirements per channel

process: Evaluate channel fit by product category and price point.
Compare fee structures (referral fees, fulfillment fees, subscription costs).
Assess the audience overlap with your target customer.
Select the channels and document the requirements for each.

steps.description: Create and configure seller accounts on each marketplace.
process: Register the seller account on each platform.
Complete the verification process (business documents, tax ID, bank account).
Configure the store profile (name, logo, description, policies).
Set up the API credentials for order and inventory sync.

steps.description: Create and optimize product listings for each marketplace.
process: Adapt product titles to each marketplace's search algorithm.
Optimize images per channel requirements (white background, lifestyle).
Write bullet points and descriptions using marketplace keyword data.
Set pricing per channel accounting for fees and competitive position.

steps.description: Configure order sync and inventory management across channels.
process: Connect order management to each marketplace via API.
Configure inventory sync to prevent overselling.
Set up automated order import and status updates.
Test the end-to-end flow (order placed, imported, fulfilled, status updated).

description: Manage customer reviews from collection through sentiment analysis.

steps.description: Set up automated review collection from customers.
process: Design the post-purchase review request email (timing, copy, incentive).
Set up in-app or on-site review prompts.
Configure review syndication across channels.
Set frequency caps to avoid over-requesting.

steps.description: Monitor incoming reviews and respond to negative reviews within SLA.
process: Aggregate reviews from all channels into a single dashboard.
Flag reviews that require a response (negative, questions, complaints).
Draft and post responses within the SLA.
Escalate unresolved issues to customer support.

steps.description: Analyze review sentiment trends and produce the management report.

outputs.name: sentiment-analysis
outputs.desc: Sentiment trends by product and category

process: Categorize reviews by sentiment (positive, neutral, negative).
Identify recurring themes and product issues.
Calculate review volume, average rating, and response rate.
Produce the review management report with improvement recommendations.

description: Design a subscription box product from audience definition through churn tracking.

steps.description: Define the target audience and value proposition for the subscription box.

inputs.name: market-research
inputs.desc: Market research on the target segment

process: Define the target customer persona (demographics, interests, pain points).
Identify the unmet need the subscription solves.
Articulate the value proposition (surprise, convenience, savings, curation).
Define the competitive positioning against alternatives.

steps.description: Select the product curation strategy and pricing model.

outputs.name: curation-strategy
outputs.desc: Product curation approach and sourcing plan

process: Choose the curation model (curated, personalized, surprise, or fixed).
Source products and negotiate supplier terms.
Set pricing tiers (monthly, quarterly, annual with discount).
Calculate unit economics (COGS, shipping, packaging, margin).

steps.description: Design the unboxing experience and packaging.
process: Design the outer packaging (branded box, tissue, stickers).
Plan the product arrangement for visual impact on opening.
Create the box insert content (product guide, personalized note, bonus item).
Spec the packaging materials and costs.

steps.description: Plan the fulfillment logistics for recurring subscription shipments.
process: Define the monthly fulfillment timeline (cutoff, assembly, ship).
Set up the assembly process (kitting, quality check, packing).
Configure the shipping method and carrier.
Plan for subscriber count scaling (warehouse space, labor).

steps.description: Set up churn tracking and retention programs.

outputs.name: churn-metrics
outputs.desc: Churn rate tracking and cohort analysis setup

process: Define churn metrics (monthly churn rate, LTV, payback period).
Set up cohort tracking by sign-up month.
Design retention interventions (skip option, gift, survey before cancel).
Produce the complete subscription box plan.

description: Execute a flash sale from product selection through post-sale fulfillment.

steps.description: Select products, set discount levels, and reserve inventory.
process: Select products based on excess inventory, margin room, or traffic goals.
Set discount levels that meet margin floors.
Reserve inventory to prevent overselling.
Calculate the expected revenue and margin impact.

steps.description: Prepare the marketing assets and landing pages for the sale.
process: Design the email announcement and reminder sequence.
Create social media and ad creatives.
Build or configure the sale landing page with countdown timer.
Schedule the marketing sends aligned to the sale window.

steps.description: Monitor real-time performance and manage post-sale fulfillment.

outputs.name: sale-performance
outputs.desc: Real-time sales, revenue, and inventory data

process: Monitor sales velocity, inventory levels, and site performance in real time.
Adjust inventory reserves or extend the sale window if needed.
Process the surge in orders through fulfillment.
Produce the post-sale report (revenue, units sold, margin, new customers).

description: Set up a dropshipping operation from niche selection through supplier management.

steps.description: Select the product niche and evaluate potential suppliers.
process: Research niches by demand volume, competition, and margin potential.
Evaluate supplier options (reliability, shipping speed, product quality, MOQ).
Order samples from top suppliers to verify quality.
Select the niche and shortlist the suppliers.

steps.description: List products on the storefront with supplier integration.
process: Import product data from supplier catalogs.
Write unique product titles and descriptions (not supplier defaults).
Set retail prices with target margin above supplier cost plus shipping.
Configure automated order routing to the supplier on purchase.

steps.description: Set up customer service processes and track supplier performance.
process: Define the customer service process for order inquiries and returns.
Set up tracking notification forwarding from supplier to customer.
Establish supplier performance metrics (ship time, defect rate, stockouts).
Produce the dropshipping operations plan with margin tracking.
